content: Kalin nuwag yakamiy
Yey Dud, Yeisuw Kelis natouwat yey. Yey tuwag Yemes. Milet balel biwekeimiy mo kukines. Tamads Yowbad nikatigikeimiy angamag bwanabwein yakamiy, ikayuseimiy-vak silma̱nin Yeisuw Kelis.
Bweina binok nuwan wasigeis yakamiy, bikatimweis nasiwa̱youb wasigeis yakamiy, bivakaein, mo beitaw nuwamiy.
Takatimlakay mwasanin asisinap kalbaleb

Sigwey, singay sivinag liva̱nen dakatuneibs balel beiw kuvinis. Tage kadiloka balel baguyeimiy va̱gan bukwayuses datapwa̱louls, peinan kweiboug Yowbad nisekeids datapwa̱louls wasigeis angamag ya̱kids.

Peinan takalbalebs mwasanin bo ikatidavimiy mo isiws wasigeis yakamiy. Peinan Yowbad nasiwa̱youb wasigeis ya̱kids bo ikatilawos, va̱gan bigigeinawls mo bipiyaves datoveks anmwa̱net, mtowen daGuyaws Yeisuw Kelis. Nagwa̱diven nikatigik va̱gan bimop asisinap kalbaleb.

Sivinag bukunuwes sinap towen kweiboug nukuliganes. Kweiboug kuliganes bwein, tage badibakeimiy vayuwein, peinan kweiboug daGuyaws nikatinabwes nagamag ven Yidipt waseg, wankuyeim mo iyagages mwasanin tasiyas, peinan nag isimounids waseg.
Min-liba̱lab-vak mwasanin tatineisina ikamumwa̱nes, mo ilisawes siven tatineis, mapuna Yowbad iyawanis nisesus watinow, dadub waseg, yam babaw ee... tutan Yowbad bikatukin gamag babaw wasigeis.

Ma̱wan-vak ven mwasanin kweiboug, Sodom, Gomol, sisiyas ven mwasanin walasin, gimgilis tasiyas-vak asisinap kalbaleb, asivikeiy silma̱nin kanavay kalbaleb, Yowbad mo imop asisinap kalbaleb kov waseg bigidaged nag beikous. Ya̱kids, bitaliganes, mo bika̱kin matads.

Tage gamag tasiyas neisiws wasigeis yakamiy, asisinap ma̱wan kalbaleb, ikammikons mo ivag asisinap kalbaleb, waseg iyagages wous tatineis. Kaleiwag ipiyaves. Iyages-vak min-liba̱lab tasiyas takamnats.
Min-liba̱lab sitovek Maykel kweiboug ikamnimans son Seitan, silma̱nin Moses won bikow, tage nag ikan Seitan, nag iyeg, nag. Deisina ilivan, ilana, “DaGuyaws bisilbwadeim.”
Tage gamag tasiyas iyages aveiyag nag ikakins. Ma̱wana bulawud tasiyas, ninous nag, siwotet ma̱wana asvikeiy tatineis, mapuna iyagagesa tatineis.

Singay kalbaleb bilivatus tasiyas. Isiked ma̱wana Kayin kweiboug, sivines kid biguyaws, mo ipiyaves sinap bwein, iyousis gog Ba̱lam ansinap kalbaleb, mo imta̱mats, peinan ipiyaves kaleiwag, ma̱wana Kolak kweiboug.

Tasiyas misagal siwa̱youb tapwa̱loul waseg bo iyagages, peinan takamkwams tasiyas, tage nag ivag asimwasin. Sivines kid simwa̱sawa tatineis; askakin ma̱wana makava bwaw, nag ivag kweis wanuwan bwaw, makava yag iyatuwanes. Tasiyas ma̱wan-vak amweilok kaytan, wuwal waseg nag beiwuw, mapuna bigutes bilaves, va̱gan sivay beimat.
Tasiyas-wan ma̱wana kaysay avakaein, poulun ivag, ma̱wana asimwasin avakaein. Tasiyas ma̱wana wutun ininounas mav, siven dadub watinow mo bisesus bisigagas.

Adam tabun tabun tabun gog yagan Inok, mtowen kweiboug igeiguy, ilana, “Kukines daGuyaws bo isap, siney nagamag singay babaw. Bo bikaleiwag gamag babaw wasigeis. Tasiyas takalbalebs bikatimlakes va̱gan bikakins asisinap kalbaleb, o siwotet babaw kalbaleb niwteles asisinap babaw kalbaleb waseg; o takalbalebs tasiyas bikakins asilivan babaw kalbaleb, waseg iyages Yowbad.”
Gamag tasiyas singay nuwanaw wudous, tavtokays livan, peinan ikikuns asvikeiy tatineis; ikayya̱pams sinap asilivan tawtoun waseg. Asilivan kamnag wasigeis gamag mwasanin, va̱gan siwliyoug biba̱nes.
Kumtakavateimiy beibwein

Sigwey kuninuways, peinan tasiyas takaweins liva̱nen daGuyaws Yeisuw Kelis bo ilivnakes asisinap kalbaleb, idibakeimiy, ilansa, “Nakabiyokous tut waseg gamag bipiyaves tapwa̱loul, bisiba̱wes, peinan bikikuns asvikeiy kalbaleb waseg.”
Gamag tasiyas sivines bilivis tayekelesiys, bimlavags bod kweitan kweitan, sivines kid sinapun ven watinow. Peinan Yowbad kululuwan nag inekes tasiyas.
Tage yakamiy bwanabwein, sivinag bukukimtuweimiy va̱gan mitapwa̱loul bitawtoun; o Yowbad kululuwan bilabeimiy va̱gan bukunitougs beibwein Yowbad waseg.
Kuvna̱seimiy va̱gan tut babaw Yowbad bisiwyoubumiy. Kukwayamats, peinan daGuyaws Yeisuw Kelis ikalin nuwan wasigeis yakamiy; igaw mwamovamiy bisekeimiy nag beikous.
Gamag mwasanin nag isimounids bwein, kwatimlakes va̱gan mo bikakins bwein.

Tage mwasanin gamag bweina kwatinabwes kululuwes, mamagina kov waseg kwatinabwes. Binok nuwamiy wasigeis gamag mwasanin son amipwa̱yat, mapuna kupiyaves ven watinow vikeiyan; mata-ge biyabik amikweim.
Nakabiyokous

Towen takatinabweids anmwa̱net bweina bimtakavateimiy; mata-ge bukukwalouws; igaw mo bispuyeimiy nakamnat wamatan, amisinap kamnat son mimwa̱saw avakaein. DaGuyaws Yeisuw Kelis ilabeids mo takavasis Tatawtoun Yowbad, peinan Takaleiwag tatonen, tut kweiboug, tut towen, o igaw tut wanakougwaw nag beikous. Eimen.
